================================================================================================
BOOKING NOTES V5.3 -- 100-PRODUCT AUDIT
================================================================================================

Prompt : SYSTEM_PROMPT_FH_BOOKING_V5_3 (25 columns, heading-gated)
Model  : gpt-5.6-luna
Set    : the SAME 100 products the V5 run used, so every difference is
         caused by the prompt change and nothing else.

A column fills ONLY when the supplier wrote a heading naming it. An EMPTY
column is a CORRECT answer. Text that names no column goes to `notes` --
that is the safety net, not a failure.

WHAT CHANGED FROM V5
  - 15 columns -> 25. inclusions->what_included, location->meeting_point,
    other->notes, plus 10 new columns derived from a heading census of all
    8,244 products with booking notes.
  - Worked examples rewritten with invented names (Sample Wharf, Acme
    Parking, example.test) after V5 copied one into product 78026.
  - Stripping a markdown link must KEEP its URL. V5 lost 72 of 238 URLs.

products with something to look at : 43 of 100
products with nothing flagged      : 57 of 100

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FINDING COUNTS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
     10  ITINERARY LINE TEST -- no time, step or stop
      6  URL LOST -- a link in the raw reached no column
      5  MARKDOWN JUNK -- * or # survived into a column
      3  INVENTION -- text in a column that is not in the raw
      1  URL ALTERED -- a link was changed or invented
      1  ITEM AS HEADING -- a packing-list item opened its own column
      1  MID-SENTENCE START -- a value begins part-way through a sentence

     67  RECOVERED CONTENT -- raw text that reached no column
     21  REWORDED -- present but not verbatim (a VERBATIM defect)
     28  DUPLICATED -- same sentence in 2+ columns (reported, not removed)

    200  review signal only -- a heading named a column but the model
         routed the content elsewhere. Measured: 161 of 200 had the content
         present in another column; only 8 were genuinely absent. NOT defects.

  RAW BOOKING NOTES
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ⚠️ 2026 Frankton Trail Update
    Between mid-January and mid-November 2026, a short section of the Frankton Track is
    closed while Queenstown Lakes District Council completes underground wastewater upgrades.
    During this period:
    • A 3km sealed lakeside cycle path alongside Frankton Road will be used
    • The full Arrowtown to Queenstown ride continues as normal
    • The alternative section is smooth and suitable for all riders
    No action required — your experience remains unchanged.
    ## 🚐 Pick-Up Options
    ### Meet & Greet Point – Queenstown CBD
    🤝 Your meeting point is bus stop [The Station Building – 43 Camp
    Street](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wYKkkDn8ELBjLFtz6), outside Marmolada Café, on the corner
    of Camp & Shotover Streets (next to Red Rock and opposite BroBike).
    Please arrive **5 minutes early** and have your phone off silent in case we need to reach
    you.
    ---
    ### Private Address Pickup
    If you’ve arranged **door-to-door pickup**, we’ll message you via WhatsApp or SMS with
    the exact time. It will likely be **5–20 minutes before or after 10:00 AM or 12:00 PM**,
    depending on your pickup location.
    ---
    ### Parking at HQ
    🅿️ Parking is free all day at our shop:
    [Unit 36 / 159 Gorge Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QqD2cSUSrmc4VdSu7)
    Message us to confirm departure times if you'd like to leave from here.
    ---
    ### 📍 Wilcox Green Pickup (Arrowtown)
    If you selected **Wilcox Green, Arrowtown** as your meet-up location, we'll meet you at
    the end of Nairn Street — look for the wooden **WILCOX GREEN** sign on the grass beside
    the gravel parking:
    📍 [Wilcox Green, 2 Nairn Street, Arrowtown
    9302](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Wilcox+Green,+Arrowtown+9302/@-44.9391356,168.8372809,17z)
    - **10:25 AM** for the 10:00 session
    - **12:25 PM** for the 12:00 session
    ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/p9UYV0TAS2hiteWw6AJq)
    ---
    ### If You’re Booked for the 12:00 PM Trip
    Expect to be met between **12:00 – 12:25 PM** at your selected location.
    ---
    ## 🚲 Upon Arrival at Arrowtown
    - You'll receive a full trail briefing and get fitted to your bike
    - We highly recommend spending a little time exploring Arrowtown before riding
    - The ride is approx. **3 hrs on an e-bike** or **4 hrs on a standard pedal bike**
    - Route: Arrow River Trail → Twin Rivers Trail → Queenstown Gardens
    ![Going Blue Map](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/Nj9iGR0QdSYlCOhaT7VA)
    ---
    ## 🏁 Finish Point
    You’ll finish the ride at [Queenstown Gardens – 16 Park
    Street](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WGTBT7rDQq82sM4Z6), around:
    - **4:30 PM** for 10:00 AM sessions
    - **5:00 PM** for 12:00 PM sessions
    🚪 If you’ve arranged a door-to-door drop-off, we’ll take care of the rest.
    🔒 Please lock the bikes and message us when you’ve finished.
    ![Queenstown Gardens Map](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/kWYw0ClxRRCWdxlaPcuT)
    ---
    ## 🚲 Ride Requirements
    - Confident bike handling required
    - Dress for the conditions – **gloves are essential in winter** (available to buy on the
    day)
    - Helmets provided
    - Bring water, sunglasses, and sunscreen (note: some e-bikes may not have bottle holders)
    ---
    ## 📺 Helpful Videos
    - [How to use your e-bike](https://youtu.be/v-aVl20xKKY)
    - [Trail guide – Arrowtown to Queenstown](https://youtu.be/5enRKndAkI4)
    ---
    ## 📄 Final Bits
    - [FAQs](https://goingblue.co.nz/faqs/)
    - [Waiver Form](https://web.wherewolf.co.nz/kqrxk3)
    ---
    ## 📱 Bonus Tip – Great Ride App
    Download the **Great Rides App** to follow your progress on the trail:
    - [Google
    Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mytoursapp.android.app906&hl=en_US)
    - [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/nz/app/great-rides/id1181203029)
    ---
    📞 For help or last-minute changes, message us on WhatsApp at [+64 27 746
    2583](https://wa.me/64277462583) or text 0277 GOBLUE.

    ###AHOY CAPTAIN!
    Thanks for booking in with Adventure sailing, we look forward to getting you out on the
    water for your RST!
    ##Please meet at 9am at Port Geographe Marina, at the Adventure Sailing Office directly
    behind the marina office.
    We are usually finished by 2-3pm.
    (2/21 Spinnaker Blvd, Geographe, 6280, WA)
    ***You will need to find our classroom as per the directions above as google maps will
    just bring you to the marina entrance.***
    In preparation for your upcoming [Recreational Skipper ticket
    course](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/imarine/recreational-skippers-ticket.asp) you are
    required to obtain some paperwork to meet the Department of Transport requirements.
    ***If you have booked someone else in, please make sure they read this confirmation email
    and the reminder email.***
    ##Please select your appropriate group.
    1. ***Over 18 with drivers licence*** You simply bring your WA drivers licence with you
    on the day of your course.
    2. ***Under 18 with drivers licence or learners permit*** You will need your licence or
    learners permit with this [Parent consent
    form](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/mediaFiles/marine/MAC_F_ProFormaLetterOfConsent.pdf).
    3. ***Under 18 NO LICENCE or Learners Permit***
    • You need this [Parent consent
    form](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/mediaFiles/marine/MAC_F_ProFormaLetterOfConsent.pdf).
    • A completed [Eyesight
    test](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/mediaFiles/marine/MAC_F_RST_Eyesight.pdf) (must be
    done by GP, Optometrist or Registered nurse) Must be done on the attached form. DO NOT DO
    MEDICAL UNLESS YOU HAVE A CONDITION THAT WOULD AFFECT YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A BOAT.
    • ID. (The easiest ID is a AUST passport less than 2 years old) If you don’t have a
    passport other methods that are acceptable are listed on page 10 of your attached [RST
    Workbook](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/mediaFiles/marine/MAC_P_RST_Workbook7.pdf).
    4. ***IT IS A REQUIREMENT THAT YOU WILL COMPLETE THE PRE-COURSE STUDY!***
    Please DO NOT turn up until you have done this!
    This means completing the [ONLINE THEORY TRAINING COURSE, PRACTICAL TRAINING VIDEO &
    QUIZZES](https://seasoaringmarine.com/register/adventure-sailing-rst-online-theory-training-course/?ca=2321f8587da49fc396cab722442812de).
    Please study well. You MUST complete the course above before arriving on the day of your
    course. With the above link to the online course, you will be required to make a login.
    The course will take you 1.5 to 2 hours to complete.
    This is your boating driver’s licence, and you will NOT be awarded this licence if you do
    not pass.
    For reference here is a copy of the [DOT Skippers ticket
    handbook](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/mediaFiles/marine/MAC_P_RST_Workbook2024.pdf),
    Once you have all your paperwork sorted you are ready to do the course.
    Please use the link provided below to log in, create your own password and to access our
    Online RST Theory Training Course and Practical Assessment Videos. Please check your spam
    or trash folders in case sitting there. This is compulsory viewing before attending your
    RST course.
    We will be monitoring your progress online and if you have not completed all 5 theory
    training modules and clicked on Complete Course after watching the Practical Assessment
    video, you will be unable to attend the course on the booked date. If you do not pass the
    theory test on the allocated day you will need to reschedule another theory assessment,
    on another day, at no extra charge.
    ##PLEASE BRING
    • RELEVENT PAPERWORK & ID
    • HAT (and Sun/wind/rain proof gear depending on weather forecast)
    • WATERBOTTLE & LUNCH
    • SHOES
    You must bring your Driver’s Licence (or Learner’s Permit) with you as we use this to
    satisfy ID and eyesight requirements.
    (If you don't have a drivers licence please bring relevant ID [Proof of ID
    Info](https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/imarine/how-to-get-an-rst.asp)
    ##WE PROVIDE
    • Instructors & Boats
    • Sunscreen
    • Test papers
    • Assessment and Certificates
    • Insurance
    ##Checklist
    • ID (Passport or Drivers licence) [Other ID options listed here]
    (https://www.transport.wa.gov.au/licensing/identity/prove-your-identity/identity-requirements-existing)
    • Eyesight test if required
    • Medical if required (only if you have a medical condition that could affect driving a
    boat)
    • Parent consent (if under 18yo)
    • Have completed the online course and quizzes
    • Hat
    • Water bottle & Lunch
    • Shoes
    ##See you soon for a great day of learning!
    For more info or questions **please do not reply to this email** as we won't see it!
    Send an email to [hello@adventuresailing.com.au] (hello@adventuresailing.com.au) or call
    0428372931
    www.adventuresailing.com.au

  AUTOMATED FINDINGS

    Thank you for booking your Fishing Charter with Batemans Bay Fishing. Please note the
    following details and contact us immediately should you have any concerns:
    Departure Time: 6.00am
    Return Time: 11.30am approx.
    Location: Berth C1, Batemans Bay Marina, Beach Road, Batemans Bay
    Parking is near the Raine & Horne real estate building
    It is essential that you arrive at the Marina at least 5‐10 minutes prior to the time
    provided above. If you are late to arrive the Skipper CAN NOT WAIT for you and the
    charter will leave without you. There are no refunds or alternate trips provided if you
    miss your charter because you are late to arrive.
    ****The Charter is strictly non‐smoking and no alcohol to be brought on board*****
    We wish you all the very best of fishing on your charter and should you have any
    questions prior to your day of departure please do not hesitate to contact us on 1800 639
    396. *Should you need to contact the Skipper on the morning of your trip please call 0423
    612 250 between 5am ‐ 6am ONLY.*
    Courtesy Bus available for pick up and drop off, please contact the booking office should
    you require this service.
    M.V. JEAN MARIE
    BATEMANS BAY FISHING
    CANCELLATION POLICY
    CANCELLING YOUR TRIP PRIOR TO DAY OF DEPARTURE
    Payment is required in full upon booking your charter. You may cancel or re‐book for
    another day ONE WEEK PRIOR to the day of your charter without any loss of your monies
    paid. Should you make a cancellation within one week of departure, for any reason, you
    will not receive a refund.
    PRIOR TO DEPARTURE
    If the skipper calls the charter off due to bad weather you will have the option of the\
    next day fishing if possible or if this is not possible a refund of monies paid for your
    fishing.
    If you are out fishing and the skipper calls the charter off within 2 hours of your
    charter, you have the same option of a return trip or refund. If you are out to sea for 2
    hours or more then there is no refund or return trip given.
    If the skipper has doubts about the weather and advises not to go but you wish to go
    anyway there will be no refunds. If you call a charter off and wish to come in early
    there will be no refunds.
    AT SEA
    If you have been at sea for under two hours and the skipper calls the charter off due to
    bad weather you will have the option of the next day fishing if possible or if this is
    not possible a refund of monies paid for your fishing.
    If you have been at sea for more than two hours and either the skipper or all of the
    passengers call the charter off there will be no refunds.
    SEA SICKNESS
    If you call a charter off because of sea sickness there will be no refunds.
    For combined charters where sea sickness occurs, the charter must continue.
    We highly recommend that you seek medical advice and obtain sea sick medication if you
    think you may suffer from sea sickness. The skipper is unable to provide you with any
    medication.
    Returning a passenger to shore due to sea sickness will only occur if the skipper deems
    it necessary. If on combined charters some members are sick and some are not and the
    remainder of the passengers wish to continue with the charter, the skipper may return
    passengers to shore and then go back out to complete the charter. Should this option be
    taken the passengers wishing to return to shore will need to pay additional funds to
    cover the cost of petrol. The cost of such a return journey will depend on the estimated
    fuel usage and the amount will be told to the passengers before the return journey.
    Minimum cost $80.
    WHERE WE FISH
    Your skipper is extremely experienced and is able to provide you the benefits of local
    knowledge. Where we fish also depends on weather conditions and your skipper will take
    you to the appropriate fishing grounds comparable with weather conditions. Distance out
    to sea will also be dependent on weather, current and a variety of sea conditions. Whilst
    every effort is made to catch fish we can not guarantee fish. It is extremely rare that
    you would not catch a fish and you are able to keep what you catch providing that the
    fish are legally able to be kept. Your fish are cleaned, bagged and iced for you to take
    home. We recommend that you have an esky in the car so that you can transport your fish
    home.
    ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/sJXa6f8NTPOmo5AMvkxT)

        SEA SICKNESS:
        If you call a charter off because of sea sickness there will be no refunds.
        For combined charters where sea sickness occurs, the charter must continue.
        We highly recommend that you seek medical advice and obtain sea sick medication if
        you think you may suffer from sea sickness. The skipper is unable to provide you with
        any medication.
        Returning a passenger to shore due to sea sickness will only occur if the skipper
        deems it necessary. If on combined charters some members are sick and some are not
        and the remainder of the passengers wish to continue with the charter, the skipper
        may return passengers to shore and then go back out to complete the charter. Should
        this option be taken the passengers wishing to return to shore will need to pay
        additional funds to cover the cost of petrol. The cost of such a return journey will
        depend on the estimated fuel usage and the amount will be told to the passengers
        before the return journey. Minimum cost $80.

    Please check your booking carefully and arrive at the meeting location selected for your
    tour.

    Please wait outside the Eichardt’s Hotel.
    **Address:** 2 Marine Parade, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pK9XELRkRrU83L1Z8)
    **Wanaka Pick-Up – 09:30am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Wanaka i-SITE Visitor Centre.
    **Address:** 103 Ardmore Street, Wanaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d9k2RXVCbSu4mPcT6)
    Please note that parking is not available at our Queenstown or Wanaka pick-up locations.
    If you are driving, please allow extra time to find parking nearby and walk to the
    meeting point before your scheduled check-in time.
    Central Queenstown Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 10 Boundary Street, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wCbBz8Pn6U2zLY1i9)
    Central Wanaka Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 100 Ardmore Street, Wānaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rthzsqAMajBZWRo57)
    **Makarora Self-Drive – 10:30am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Makarora Country Cafe with your vehicle.
    From here, you will follow our vehicle to the canyon access point, located just a few
    minutes from here.
    **Address:** 5507 Makarora-Lake Hawea Road, Makarora 9382
    [Google Maps Pin:](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yaX6EJbYkNxB8Wiq8)
    ### Important: Please Arrive on Time
    Our guides begin preparing the group as soon as check-in opens to ensure a safe and
    timely departure. As we operate multiple tours each day and need to respect the schedules
    of all guests, we are unable to delay departures for late arrivals.
    ### What to Bring
    Please bring:
    * Swimwear to wear under your wetsuit
    * A towel for after the adventure
    * A personal water bottle
    * Any personal medications you may require
    For your peace of mind, we recommend leaving unnecessary valuables at home.
    Your dry clothes and personal belongings can be stored in our locked vehicle while you
    are in the canyon. While we have never experienced any security issues, we still
    recommend bringing only what you need for the adventure.
    ### Lunch
    A fresh picnic-style lunch is included and will be provided during the day.
    ### Important Safety Information
    Please take the time to review our risk acknowledgement Information before your
    adventure:
    **[Please Read](https://www.canyoningnewzealand.co.nz/safety/)**
    Please contact us before your tour if you have any injuries, medical conditions, or
    concerns about your suitability for the activity. Please also note that all bookings are
    subject to our 48-hour cancellation policy.
    ### Need Assistance?
    Our friendly reservations team is here to help.
    **Phone:** +64 3 428 0071
    **Open daily:** 8:00am – 8:00pm
    ### Tiaki Promise
    New Zealand is a truly special place, and everyone who lives here or visits has a
    responsibility to help protect it. The Tiaki Promise is a commitment to care for
    Aotearoa, now and for future generations.
    By embracing the Tiaki Promise, you are choosing to act as a guardian — respecting the
    land, protecting the environment, and preserving the natural beauty we are privileged to
    explore.
    **Nau mai, haere mai ki Aotearoa — Welcome to New Zealand!**
    **[Learn more](https://www.tiakinewzealand.com/en_NZ/)**
    ### Help Keep New Zealand Wild
    We're committed to reducing our environmental impact and offsetting our carbon footprint
    by planting native trees throughout the Wakatipu region.
    If you'd like to support this initiative, you can make a voluntary $5 contribution here:
    **[Donate
    Now](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/canyoningnewzealand/items/387858/calendar/?flow=489300&full-items=yes)**
    Thank you for choosing Canyoning New Zealand. We look forward to sharing an unforgettable
    day of adventure, wilderness and incredible scenery with you.
    See you soon!

    ## About
    WHAT IS HIGH PERFORMANCE ALL ABOUT?
    Our high performance coaching camps are about reaching your true surfing ability with the
    help of a few clever strategies, delivered by our highly qualified, professional and
    friendly coaches.
    WHAT STRATEGIES DO YOU USE?
    Video Analysis: We use video analysis to improve your surfing technique and skill level.
    Our high performance coaches film your surfing session from the beach, then sit with you
    to go over your footage in detail and give you constructive feedback on your strengths
    and areas in need of improvement. You then get to go back out in the water to put the
    advice in to practice. You will be amazed at how the slightest tweak can make you look
    and feel like a whole new and improved surfer!
    Surf Skate boards: No wave is ever the same and conditions are forever changing. Practice
    makes improvements and getting the feel of how your body should be balanced and
    positioned is really important to nailing those turns you have always dreamed of! Our
    Surf Skate boards are purpose built to create the same feeling of surfing and let you
    repeatedly practice a manoeuvre (on land) with our high performance coaches right there
    giving instant feedback.
    Competition Practice: This is optional for those participants who are competition
    surfers. If requested, we can hold mock competitions and run through successful heat
    strategies to improve your confidence and technique to be ready for your next comp.
    ___________________________________

    **Hi there,**
    Thank you for enrolling in the **Open Water Diver Course with Dive Eden** — we’re
    thrilled to have you join us! Learning to dive is an incredible step toward new
    adventures, whether you’re dreaming of exploring local reefs, travelling to tropical
    destinations, spotting unique marine life, or simply experiencing the magic of breathing
    underwater for the first time. Whatever your reason, we’re excited to help you begin your
    journey.
    Below is some important information to help you prepare for your course. If anything is
    unclear, please feel free to reach out.
    **1. Equipment**
    All equipment is included for use during your Open Water Course. If you already own
    personal items such as a mask or snorkel, you’re welcome to bring them. We also have
    equipment available for purchase if you’d like to start building your own dive kit.
    **2. Register and complete your course materials**
    To begin your training, you’ll need to create an **SSI account** (at
    [https://my.divessi.com](https://my.divessi.com)) and affiliate with **Dive Eden**. This
    will give you access to your online learning materials and the required forms. Please
    complete all course materials, documents and the final exam before your first training
    day.
    **To set up your SSI account:**
    Create your profile at [https://my.divessi.com](https://my.divessi.com) and affiliate
    with Dive Eden. Please reach out once you've created your MySSI profile and your course
    materials will be allocated within 48 hours.
    **Before your course commences, within MySSI, please ensure you have:**
    - Created an account and affiliated with Dive Eden
    - Completed all online course materials and the final exam. You can access your materials
    under **“Courses”** in the MySSI App or under **“Training”** on the website.
    - Completed the Medical Questionnaire†, Responsible Diver Code, and Assumption of Risk &
    Liability Waiver (found in the “Documents” section)
    - Added your home address to your profile
    - Uploaded a profile photo (no sunglasses, hats, or masks — but smiling is encouraged)
    **†Important health note:**
    Recreational scuba diving and freediving require good physical and mental health. Some
    medical conditions can increase the risks associated with diving. The **Diver Medical
    Participant Questionnaire** helps determine whether you should be assessed by a physician
    before participating. For your safety — and the safety of those diving with you — please
    answer all questions honestly and well in advance of the course to allow time for any
    questions. If you are feeling unwell at any time, it’s important to avoid diving.
    **3. Approximate schedule**
    **Day 1**
    9:00am – Meet at Strickland Lane, Eden
    1:00–2:00pm – Lunch Approx.
    3:00–5:30pm – Finish
    **Day 2**
    9:00am – Meet at Strickland Lane, Eden
    12:00pm – Lunch
    5:00pm – Finish
    **Day 3 (if required)**
    9:00am – Meet at Strickland Lane, Eden
    12:00pm – Lunch
    4:00pm – Finish
    **4. What to bring**
    - Lunch, snacks, and water
    - Sunscreen and any personal snorkelling or diving gear you already own
    - Swimwear
    - Towel and warm clothes for after the dive
    - Enthusiasm and a sense of adventure
    **5. How to find us**
    We’ll meet at the Dive Eden shed to collect equipment. You’ll find us on **Strickland
    Lane, Eden**, underneath **Brent Dunne Design**.
    Alternatively, you can park on the main street and walk through the arcade between Mark
    Anthony’s and Anna Warren’s Gallery, then head down the staircase at the back.
    (Please note: Google Maps may direct you incorrectly. Look for BD Design, an open shed,
    and our green *Dive Eden* Landcruiser.)
    ![Location](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/Msd46uP0RFi7NpPJVv47)
    Taking your first breaths underwater is something you’ll never forget — and it opens the
    door to a lifetime of exploration, exhilaration, and connection with the ocean.
    If you have any questions at all, just let me know.
    I’m looking forward to diving with you soon!
    **Jayde Rankin and the Dive Eden Team**
    SSI and PADI Scuba and Freediving Instructor
    [diveeden@gmail.com](mailto:diveeden@gmail.com)
    [www.diveeden.com.au](www.diveeden.com.au)
    0410 026 990

    **ITINERARY**
    **08.50am Arrive** Meet at Mighty River Domain, Karapiro. Take Gate 2, then your first
    right. Park on the grass under the trees. Ensure your bikes are ready to go.
    **09.00am 1x way Shuttle transfer from Mighty River Domain, to Ngāruawāhia.** We will
    load personal bikes onto shuttle.
    **10.00am arrive at Ngāruawāhia.** On arrival, receive a quick overview of the route and
    trail tips. For anyone with hired RAW bikes, there will be an induction prior to hitting
    the trail.
    **10.05am Ride at your own pace.** Begin your scenic ride along the Te Awa River Ride,
    making your way back to Mighty River Domain at your leisure.
    **Finish.** - Complete your ride back at Mighty River Domain, where your vehicle will be
    waiting. We estimate 1 hour for every 10km biked, less if on eBike. For customers hiring
    a Riverside Adventures Waikato bike, an additional fee applies for bike collection and
    return to our Cambridge Town Hall base.
    **Arrival times to Ngāruawāhia are approximate, as we may make additional pick-ups and
    drop-offs along the way.*
    **What's included**
    * 1 way Shuttle transfer from Mighty River Domain, Karapiro to Ngāruawāhia,
    * Transport for you and your bike.
    * Bike loading and unloading assistance.
    * Local tips and recommendations before departure.

    **Pricing**
    Our shuttle price is based on your group booking, with a minimum fare covering 1 - 4
    people. The same minimum price applies whether you are travelling solo or with up to
    three others. Prices are not split between different groups, as other bookings may change

    **Important Information**
    - Shuttle departs at scheduled times—please arrive on time, as late arrivals may miss
    departure
    - Non-standard bikes (e.g. trailers or large e-bikes) must be advised in advance.
    - Children must be accompanied and supervised by an adult.
    **Special requirements**
    * Minimum four people required for regular bookings; call to book if you have fewer than
    four.
    * All riders must wear a helmet (compulsory).
    * Participants must arrive on time for departure.
    * Children must be accompanied and supervised by an adult.

    * Shuttle operates at specified times only—late arrivals may miss departure.
    * Non-standard bikes (e.g. trailers, large e-bikes) must be advised in advance.
    * Children must be accompanied by an adult.
    **Disclaimers**
    * Bookings are essential
    * Minimum fare covers 1–4 people and is charged to ensure the shuttle can operate. Prices
    are not split between different groups; the same minimum price applies whether travelling
    solo or with up to three others.
    * Riverside Adventures Waikato is not responsible for weather conditions on the day &
    operates in most weather conditions.
    * Trail conditions may vary and are outside of our control.
    * Ride times and distances are estimates and will vary depending on ability and stops.
    * No refunds will be given for no-shows or late arrivals.

  RAW BOOKING NOTES
  --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ###eFoilgc Access Statement
    At eFoilgc we believe that adventure should be accessible to all. We aim to break down
    barriers and empower individuals with disabilities to experience the joy of eFoil and
    Jetboard riding. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can
    thrive.
    In this statement, we aim to accurately describe our offering so you can decide if it
    suits your specific requirements.
    ###Getting Here
    We run our rides from the eastern end of Winders Park at Currumbin. Winders Park is on
    Duringan Street. You can get to the park on public transport or by car.
    If you’re taking public transport, there is a bus stop less than 20 metres from our
    launching point.
    There is public parking but no designated accessible parking nearby. You can drop off
    close by.
    eFoilgc operates from the eastern end of Winders Park
    ###The Experience
    eFoilgc provides one on one instruction and the ride can be tailored to individual
    abilities.
    You will be provided with a board that will best suit your needs.
    One on one instruction and assistance
    You will need to have enough upper body strength to be able to hang on to the board and
    transfer your weight back and forward. You will also need to be able to use the hand
    control to operate the board.
    Your instructor will accompany you on a separate board. You will be provided with a
    headset for communication. Your instructor will be in radio contact with you at all
    times.
    We can also offer escorted rides. For these rides, you are the passenger, and the board
    is controlled by the instructor.
    You will get wet, and it can be cold at times, so if you have a wetsuit, please bring it
    along. If you do not have a wetsuit we can provide you with a rashie. You will be fitted
    with a life vest.
    The entry point to the water changes depending on the tide. There is some sand to cross
    to get to the water’s edge. eFoilgc staff will help transfer you if needed.
    ###Boat ramp at low tide
    There is also a boat ramp nearby of a moderate gradient. The surface is grooved. The boat
    ramp is another option for entry to the water.
    ###Rider with instructor alongside
    The on shore assessment and instruction will take up to 25 minutes to complete. You will
    then be on the water for at least 25 minutes.
    ###A rider having the board ‘foiling’
    While you are on the water your instructor can take photos of you. You will be given the
    photos at no extra cost.
    A video will also be taken and can be purchased at a separate cost.
    ###Booking
    If you have access requirements, we recommend you phone us to make your booking. We can
    discuss your needs during the call which will help us to understand how we can best
    support you to enjoy your eFoil experience.
    ###Amenities
    There is a public amenity block approximately 300 metres from the launching point. It
    includes a right hand unisex accessible toilet.
    There is a beach shower approximately 150 metres from the launching point.

    ## Thank You for Booking with Canyoning New Zealand!
    We're excited to welcome you on our **Mt Aspiring XXL Full Day Adventure** and can't wait
    to share one of New Zealand’s most spectacular wilderness experiences with you.
    ## Before Your Adventure
    ### Meeting Locations & Parking
    Please check your booking carefully and arrive at the meeting location selected for your
    tour.
    **Queenstown Pick-Up – 08:20am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Eichardt’s Hotel.
    **Address:** 2 Marine Parade, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pK9XELRkRrU83L1Z8)
    **Wanaka Pick-Up – 09:30am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Wanaka i-SITE Visitor Centre.
    **Address:** 103 Ardmore Street, Wanaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d9k2RXVCbSu4mPcT6)
    Please note that parking is not available at our Queenstown or Wanaka pick-up locations.
    If you are driving, please allow extra time to find parking nearby and walk to the
    meeting point before your scheduled check-in time.
    Central Queenstown Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 10 Boundary Street, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wCbBz8Pn6U2zLY1i9)
    Central Wanaka Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 100 Ardmore Street, Wānaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rthzsqAMajBZWRo57)
    **Makarora Self-Drive – 10:30am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Makarora Country Cafe with your vehicle.
    From here, you will follow our vehicle to the canyon access point, located just a few
    minutes from here.
    **Address:** 5507 Makarora-Lake Hawea Road, Makarora 9382
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/phY9diLaAKX2uUcw7)
    ### Important: Please Arrive on Time
    Our guides begin preparing the group as soon as check-in opens to ensure a safe and
    timely departure. As we operate multiple tours each day and need to respect the schedules
    of all guests, we are unable to delay departures for late arrivals.
    ### What to Bring
    Please bring:
    * Swimwear to wear under your wetsuit
    * A towel for after the adventure
    * A personal water bottle
    * Any personal medications you may require
    For your peace of mind, we recommend leaving unnecessary valuables at home.
    Your dry clothes and personal belongings can be stored in our locked vehicle while you
    are in the canyon. While we have never experienced any security issues, we still
    recommend bringing only what you need for the adventure.
    ### Lunch
    A fresh picnic-style lunch is included and will be provided during the day.
    ### Important Safety Information
    Please take the time to review our risk acknowledgement Information before your
    adventure:
    **[Please Read](https://www.canyoningnewzealand.co.nz/safety/)**
    Please contact us before your tour if you have any injuries, medical conditions, or
    concerns about your suitability for the activity. Please also note that all bookings are
    subject to our 48-hour cancellation policy.
    ### Need Assistance?
    Our friendly reservations team is here to help.
    **Phone:** +64 3 428 0071
    **Open daily:** 8:00am – 8:00pm
    ### Tiaki Promise
    New Zealand is a truly special place, and everyone who lives here or visits has a
    responsibility to help protect it. The Tiaki Promise is a commitment to care for
    Aotearoa, now and for future generations.
    By embracing the Tiaki Promise, you are choosing to act as a guardian — respecting the
    land, protecting the environment, and preserving the natural beauty we are privileged to
    explore.
    **Nau mai, haere mai ki Aotearoa — Welcome to New Zealand!**
    **[Learn more](https://www.tiakinewzealand.com/en_NZ/)**
    ### Help Keep New Zealand Wild
    We're committed to reducing our environmental impact and offsetting our carbon footprint
    by planting native trees throughout the Wakatipu region.
    If you'd like to support this initiative, you can make a voluntary $5 contribution here:
    **[Donate
    Now](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/canyoningnewzealand/items/387858/calendar/?flow=489300&full-items=yes)**
    Thank you for choosing Canyoning New Zealand. We look forward to sharing an unforgettable
    day of adventure, wilderness and incredible scenery with you.
    See you soon!

    ## Thank You for Booking with Canyoning New Zealand!
    We're excited to welcome you on our **Mt Aspiring MAX Full Day Adventure** and can't wait
    to share one of New Zealand’s most spectacular wilderness experiences with you.
    ## Before Your Adventure
    ### Meeting Locations & Parking
    Please check your booking carefully and arrive at the meeting location selected for your
    tour.
    **Queenstown Pick-Up – 06.50am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Eichardt’s Hotel.
    **Address:** 2 Marine Parade, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/pK9XELRkRrU83L1Z8)
    **Wanaka Pick-Up – 08:00am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Wanaka i-SITE Visitor Centre.
    **Address:** 103 Ardmore Street, Wanaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d9k2RXVCbSu4mPcT6)
    Please note that parking is not available at our Queenstown or Wanaka pick-up locations.
    If you are driving, please allow extra time to find parking nearby and walk to the
    meeting point before your scheduled check-in time.
    Central Queenstown Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 10 Boundary Street, Queenstown 9300
    [Google Maps Pin](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wCbBz8Pn6U2zLY1i9)
    Central Wanaka Parking Suggestion
    **Address:** 100 Ardmore Street, Wānaka 9305
    [Google Maps Pin] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rthzsqAMajBZWRo57)
    **Makarora Self-Drive – 09:00am meeting time**
    Please wait outside the Makarora Country Cafe with your vehicle.
    From here, you will follow our vehicle to the canyon access point, located just a few
    minutes from here.
    **Address:** 5507 Makarora-Lake Hawea Road, Makarora 9382
    [Google Maps Pin:](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yaX6EJbYkNxB8Wiq8)
    ### Important: Please Arrive on Time
    Our guides begin preparing the group as soon as check-in opens to ensure a safe and
    timely departure. As we operate multiple tours each day and need to respect the schedules
    of all guests, we are unable to delay departures for late arrivals.
    ### What to Bring
    Please bring:
    * Swimwear to wear under your wetsuit
    * A towel for after the adventure
    * A personal water bottle
    * Any personal medications you may require
    For your peace of mind, we recommend leaving unnecessary valuables at home.
    Your dry clothes and personal belongings can be stored in our locked vehicle while you
    are in the canyon. While we have never experienced any security issues, we still
    recommend bringing only what you need for the adventure.
    ###Lunch
    A fresh picnic-style lunch is included and will be provided during the day.
    ### Important Safety Information
    Please take the time to review our risk acknowledgement Information before your
    adventure:
    **[Please Read](https://www.canyoningnewzealand.co.nz/safety/)**
    Please contact us before your tour if you have any injuries, medical conditions, or
    concerns about your suitability for the activity. Please also note that all bookings are
    subject to our 48-hour cancellation policy.
    ### Need Assistance?
    Our friendly reservations team is here to help.
    **Phone:** +64 3 428 0071
    **Open daily:** 8:00am – 8:00pm
    ### Tiaki Promise
    New Zealand is a truly special place, and everyone who lives here or visits has a
    responsibility to help protect it. The Tiaki Promise is a commitment to care for
    Aotearoa, now and for future generations.
    By embracing the Tiaki Promise, you are choosing to act as a guardian — respecting the
    land, protecting the environment, and preserving the natural beauty we are privileged to
    explore.
    **Nau mai, haere mai ki Aotearoa — Welcome to New Zealand!**
    **[Learn more](https://www.tiakinewzealand.com/en_NZ/)**
    ### Help Keep New Zealand Wild
    We're committed to reducing our environmental impact and offsetting our carbon footprint
    by planting native trees throughout the Wakatipu region.
    If you'd like to support this initiative, you can make a voluntary $5 contribution here:
    **[Donate
    Now](https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/canyoningnewzealand/items/387858/calendar/?flow=489300&full-items=yes)**
    Thank you for choosing Canyoning New Zealand. We look forward to sharing an unforgettable
    day of adventure, wilderness and incredible scenery with you.
    See you soon!

    ## 🚐 Pick-Up Options
    **Main meeting point:**
    📍 [**43 Camp Street, Queenstown CBD**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/wYKkkDn8ELBjLFtz6) —
    outside Marmolada Café, corner of Camp & Shotover Street (next to Red Rock, opposite
    BroBike).
    - Be ready by **9:55 AM** for the **10:00 AM session**
    - Be ready by **11:55 AM** for the **12:00 PM session**
    **Other pick-up options (by arrangement):**
    * 🅿️ **Free parking at our shop** — [Unit 36 / 159 Gorge
    Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QqD2cSUSrmc4VdSu7). Message us to confirm shop departure
    (~9:40–9:50 AM or ~11:40–11:50 AM).
    * 📍 **Wilcox Green, Arrowtown** — [2 Nairn Street, Arrowtown
    9302](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Wilcox+Green,+Arrowtown+9302/@-44.9391356,168.8372809,17z).
    Look for the wooden **WILCOX GREEN** sign at the end of Nairn Street. Meet times:
    **~10:25 AM** for the 10:00 session / **~12:25 PM** for the 12:00 session.
    * 🏠 **Private address pickup** — time confirmed by SMS/WhatsApp, usually 5–20 mins before
    or after session start depending on your location. Keep your phone handy.
    ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/MxL35TOTSGDwVv09x1sa)
    ---
    ## 🚴 Upon Arrival at Arrowtown
    - You'll receive a full trail briefing and get fitted to your bike.
    - We highly recommend exploring historic Arrowtown before heading out.
    - Journey begins: ~1 hour down the Arrow River Trail toward Arthurs Point.
    ---
    ## 🏁 End-of-Trail Options
    **Best finish — back at base.** Roll into our shop and walk across the road to
    **Searchlight Brewery** for a celebratory beer:
    📍 [Unit 36 / 159 Gorge Road](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QqD2cSUSrmc4VdSu7)
    **Other finish points along the trail (Arthurs Point, ~4:45 PM):**
    - Canyon Brewery
    - Gantley's Tavern
    - Cargo Collective
    🚐 **No standard return shuttle** — most riders cruise back to our shop. If you're done
    for the day (or had one too many at the breweries), message us before:
    - **2:00 PM** for the 10:00 AM tour
    - **3:00 PM** for the 12:00 PM tour
    We'll arrange a pickup from any of the Arthurs Point breweries above. **Paid drop-off to
    town or accommodation available on request, subject to availability.**
    **OR**
    🌳 **Finish at Queenstown Gardens** *(by 4:30 PM)*
    📍 [Queenstown Gardens Entrance — 16 Park
    Street](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WGTBT7rDQq82sM4Z6) — 2-minute walk into town. No pickup
    from this option.
    ![Queenstown Gardens Entrance Map](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/kWYw0ClxRRCWdxlaPcuT)
    ⚠️ **Important:** The Queenstown Gardens route includes ~200 metres of road riding over
    the one-lane Edith Cavell Bridge. Only choose this if you're confident briefly on the
    road. Keep left — safety is your responsibility.
    📱 Text us once your bikes are locked 🔒
    ---
    ## 🚲 Requirements for the Ride
    - **Cycling ability** — Be comfortable on a bike before you book.
    - **Clothing & footwear** — Dress for the weather. **Gloves are a must in winter** —
    all-weather cycling gloves available for purchase on the day.
    - **Helmet** — Provided.
    - **Essentials** — Sunglasses, sunscreen, water bottle. Some smaller e-bikes don't have
    bottle holders.
    ---
    ## 📹 How-To Videos
    - [How to use the eBike](https://youtu.be/v-aVl20xKKY)
    ---
    ## 📄 FAQs and Waiver
    - [FAQs](https://goingblue.co.nz/faqs/)
    - [Waiver](https://web.wherewolf.co.nz/kqrxk3)
    ---
    ## 📱 Enhance Your Journey with the Great Rides App
    - [Google
    Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mytoursapp.android.app906&hl=en_US)
    - [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/nz/app/great-rides/id1181203029)
    ---
    📱 **For any issues, late arrivals, or to arrange paid drop-off:** (+64) 27 746 2583 on
    WhatsApp or SMS — **0277 GOBLUE**.

    # You are all booked for your surf lesson with Mangawhai Heads Surf School & Aotearoa
    Surf.
    We are stoked to have you joining us!
    **WHERE AND WHEN TO MEET**
    Meet at **Mangawhai Heads Beach**
    **147 Wintle Street,Mangawhai**
    We will be in the grass area by the large white rock opposite the bathrooms
    Please arrive 10 minutes before your lesson start time.
    Meet your coach at the exact start time of your lesson. Please do not arrive earlier to
    meet coaches.
    We often run back to back lessons. Coaches may be finishing a session, setting up, or
    taking a short break. This helps us give you our full focus once your lesson begins.
    **WHAT IS PROVIDED**
    • 90 minute surf lesson
    • All surfboards and wetsuits
    • Rash shirts
    • Dedicated qualified instructor in the water
    • A fun, safe, well run experience
    **WHAT TO BRING**
    • Togs
    • Towel
    • Hat
    • Water bottle
    • Your own board or wetsuit if you prefer
    **AFTER YOUR LESSON**
    Ask your coach about next steps and your surfing journey
    You will receive on the day
    • 10% OFF all surfboards, wetsuits, car soft racks, and accessories
    Chat to your coach about next steps. This could be another lesson, a surf program, or a
    Surf and Stay option at our Eco Pods or Glamping. Your coach can also recommend the right
    board or wetsuit for you.
    If you need anything before your lesson, get in touch. Otherwise, we will see you at the
    beach.
    Shakas
    Aotearoa Surf Team
    **OTHER PROGRAMS & LESSONS**
    **ADULTS & YOUTH**

    **KIDS ONLY**
    - [Ultimate Kids Surf Camp (5

    - [Youth Surf Camp (4 nights)](https://aotearoasurf.co.nz/youth-surf-camp/) April,

    Thank-you for booking on-board Mandrake for 2-days and 2-nights. The below information
    should contain everything you need to know about your tour, if you have any questions or
    to reconfirm your booking please contact us via the number above.
    MEETING TIME/PLACE ON AFTERNOON OF DEPARTURE:
    11:30am* @ Coral Sea Marina (South Village Meeting Point C) on the Right-Hand-Side of the
    two buildings.
    Coral Sea Marina was previously known as Abell Point Marina.
    Google Maps link for the meeting point is: https://goo.gl/maps/ouffyb6vfowvKDdt5
    Be careful not to end up at the North end meeting point.
    *If the departure time changes, you will be notified by email and/or text message. Please
    reply to this email if you have not yet provided both contact types.
    Coral Sea Marina has parking available for $13/day.
    YOUR ITINERARY:
    Mandrake doesn’t have set itineraries, as we are dependent on weather & tidal conditions.
    When you board Mandrake, the crew will go through information specific to the vessel as
    well as where you may be going in the coming days.
    IMPORTANT!
    No large backpacks or suitcases are allowed on-board Mandrake. Please only bring bags the
    same size as airline carry-on.
    Most hostel/hotels in Airlie beach have bag storage facilities for bigger bags.
    There is NO bag storage at the marina and you face missing your departure if you bring
    bags that are not allowed.
    WHAT TO BRING:
    In a small soft bag (enviro safe), we suggest that you bring the following:
    • Travel voucher from your booking agent.
    • Light Clothing / Warm clothing in cooler months (May - September)
    • Swimsuit
    • Hat
    • Sunscreen (30+ highly recommended)
    • Bath Towel and Beach Towel
    • Sunglasses
    • Insect Repellent
    • Favourite Music
    • Alcohol (no glass please) NO MORE THAN 24 cans of beer OR 4ltrs cask wine OR 1 ltr
    spirits.
    WHAT NOT TO BRING:
    • Glass bottles or Red Wine.
    • Sleeping bags or pillows.
    • Passport or important Travel Documents
    • Shampoo and Conditioner (for environmental purposes)
    • Plastic Bags (They kill our wildlife and smother the coral)
    OzSail is not responsible for any property you take on board the vessel. In particular,
    we strongly encourage you to take waterproof cameras rather than expensive digital
    cameras. Your electrical equipment will be ruined if it comes in contact with salt water.
    MEALS:
    If you haven't already confirmed with us about food allergies and/or dietary
    requirements, please call us ASAP to modify your booking.
    All main meals are included. If you love snacks and flavoured drinks (like me), you may
    like to bring some extras including flavoured drinks e.g. orange juice or soft drinks.
    WEATHER:
    Welcome to the tropics! Although our winters may be cooler. Our summer months (November
    -March) can be extremely hot and humid, especially downstairs on a boat. Unless you are
    accustomed to living in this climate, you may find it slightly uncomfortable, especially
    at night when you are sleeping. Please be prepared for this.
    ALCOHOL, SOFT DRINKS AND BOTTLED WATER:
    An Alcohol policy is in place on Mandrake. Each guest can take a maximum of 24 cans of
    beer OR 4ltrs cask wine (goon) OR 1ltr of spirits, any more than this will NOT be allowed
    on-board. All alcohol, soft drinks and bottled water must be purchased prior to boarding
    your vessel. (Please note, we do not allow glass bottles on board)
    WATER, TEA AND COFFEE:
    We provide tap water on all our vessels however it isn't cold and some people don't like
    the taste of it. During our summer months, we strongly encourage you to bring bottled
    water. We recommend at least 2 litres per day. Tea and Coffee breaks are generally in the
    morning and afternoon.
    TRAVEL SICKNESS:
    If you are not sure whether or not you may suffer from travel sickness, we suggest taking
    travel sickness tablets. Our trained crew will assist as much as possible in making you
    comfortable but they are not allowed to provide you with any medication.
    SNORKELLING GEAR:
    Masks and snorkels are all included in the price of your trip and will be distributed at
    the meeting point.
    LYCRA SUITS & WETSUITS:
    Wearing a Lycra stinger suit will prevent UV exposure and significantly reduce your risk
    to marine stingers. OzSail; requires that all passengers wear a full-length stinger suit
    or wetsuit if you wish to swim and or snorkel from our vessels.
    You will be fitted at the meeting point and are all inclusive in your ticket price.
    TRAVEL INSURANCE:
    We strongly encourage all guests travel with travel insurance with coverage for the
    following situations:
    • Damaged Property (You will be on a boat surrounded by sea water)
    • Medical Emergencies including Ambulance cover and
    • Travel Cancellation & Interruption
    --------------------------------
    Please ensure that you have read all of the above carefully.
    On the date of departure, please ensure you are at Meeting Point C at Coral Sea Marina
    (South Village) before your scheduled departure time. It is critical that the vessel
    leaves on time.
    It will take you 20 mins to walk to Coral Sea Marina from the main street of Airlie
    Beach. If the ocean is on your right-hand side you are walking in the right direction.
    TRAVEL DATES:
    At the end of your sailing adventure, OzSail have booked you a VIP table at Beaches
    Backpackers at 6:30pm for dinner and drinks followed by free entry and more VIP treatment
    at Paddy's Shenanigans, Airlie's iconic party spot.
    We recommend that you get to Airlie Beach the day before departure and leave Airlie Beach
    the day after you return to land, to enjoy the after party.
    FEEDBACK: OzSail welcomes your honest feedback to help us to improve our trips and levels
    of customer service.
    FROM ALL OF THE STAFF & CREW AT OZSAIL WE HOPE YOU HAVE A WONDERFUL WHITSUNDAY SAILING
    EXPERIENCE!

    ##Facility

    #Terms & Conditions
    **Cleanliness Policy**
    According to the strict Health and Safety guidelines governed by the City of Vincent and
    upheld by Perth Kitchen Hire, the Hire Kitchens must be left free of food remnants,
    contaminants and any signs of use after each hire session. Our commercial Kitchens Hire
    facilities is available to other parties to hire and therefore cleanliness is vital for
    uninterrupted use of Perth Kitchen Hire. During its operation Perth Kitchen Hire insists
    that the kitchen is to be left according to the standards set out in the Cleanliness
    Standard Checklist, which is provided prior to your first hire session.
    Thorough cleaning of the Kitchen and its equipment is required as part of your Lease
    Agreement. Should the kitchen be left in an unsatisfactory manner at the conclusion of a
    hire session an approved cleaner will be appointed by Perth Kitchen Hire at the Lessees
    expense. A cleaning fee of $60 will be deducted from your Security Bond, with no further
    notice. This is to ensure the Lessee is Handing over the Kitchen to the next customer in
    the highest standard of cleanliness, as specified in the Perth Kitchen Hire Cleanliness
    Standard Checklist document, you signed and agreed upon.
    Failure to comply with Perth Kitchen Hire’s cleanliness standards may result in the
    refusal to hire out kitchens in the future as this can cause a negative flow on effect to
    subsequent hirer’s experience with Perth Kitchen Hire.
    **Opening and Closing Down**
    This will be arranged prior to your booking with one of our Team.
    **Set Up**
    Permission may be given by Perth Kitchen Hire for you to deliver equipment to the kitchen
    up to 24 hours prior to your rental period. This is merely a gesture of good faith to
    allow the ‘Lessee’ sufficient time to set up. Please note that this request may be
    refused in instances where the kitchen is already hired to another party, or the facility
    is at full capacity.
    **Equipment Usage**
    A list of equipment included in the Kitchen for hire includes and is limited to:
    · All main equipment within kitchen i.e. ovens, oven trays, cooktops, benches and sinks.
    This does not include items stored on shelves that are rented by other hire clients.
    · Use of fridge shelving allocated for food preps, only during hire period, unless hired
    and paid for the purposes of storage.
    · All kitchen utensils and equipment such as pots, pans, utensils and electrical goods
    are to be supplied by you the client. No equipment is to be left at the kitchens unless
    storage arrangements have been made.
    · Should damage occur that renders any item unusable it is expected that it will be
    replaced as new by the Lessee.
    **Foodstuffs**
    It is expected that hirers will provide all necessary foodstuffs for their requirements.
    Perth Kitchen Hire will not provide any foodstuffs. Any foodstuffs left by the Lessee in
    the Kitchen after the hire period (refrigerated or not) will become the property of Perth
    Kitchen Hire and will in all likeliness be disposed of, unless storage arrangements have
    been made.
    **Deliveries**
    Perth Kitchen Hire is not responsible for receiving or checking deliveries and will not
    take any responsibility for incorrect deliveries. Please ensure that you have a
    representative on hand to receive or return any goods.
    **Parking**
    Perth Kitchen Hire is situated in a business strata title and parking is restricted to a
    few designated bays only. Parking bay usage differs during business and non-business
    hours. Access to the building is via the large sliding door and you can park temporarily
    outside this door to load and unload your vehicle. The carpark at the rear of the strata
    must be used during your hire session.
    **Utilities**
    Perth Kitchen Hire provides usage of utilities – water, power, gas and toilets as part of
    this rental agreement. Should it be deemed that unnecessary or excessive usage of these
    utilities occurs, then Perth Kitchen Hire reserves the right to oncharge these costs to
    the Lessee.
    **Safety**
    Should possibly dangerous situations or behaviour by the Lessee occur during their hire
    session, Perth Kitchen Hire reserves the right to shut the kitchen and any operations
    down. Should this be, directly through the actions of the renter, then all monies are
    non-refundable.
    **Food Safety**
    It is the responsibility of the Lessee to ensure you are operating within the
    requirements of the relevant Food Legislation for both the structure and Food Safety
    practices. Monitoring Food Safety requirements are undertaken by the Department of Health
    WA in conjunction with Local Governments and will not form part of the Perth Kitchen Hire
    responsibilities. All Local Government Registrations/Notifications, regarding your Food
    Business, is the responsibility of the Lessee.
    **Availability**
    Please note that all bookings are subject to availability and Perth Kitchen Hire reserves
    the right to cancel a booking should the kitchen be unusable for any OHS reason.
    **Probation Period**
    All bookings over a month will be subject to a 1-month probation period, during which
    time either party can cancel the Rental Agreement with no penalty.
    **Public Liability & Workers Compensation**
    The Lessee is required to confirm the attained Certificate of Currency for Public
    Liability & Workers Compensation and provide a copy along with the completed Rental
    Agreement.
    **Tax Invoice**
    Perth Kitchen Hire
    ABN: 28 185 842 792
    267 Scarborough Beach Road
    Mt Hawthorn, WA 6016

    #Terms & Conditions
    **Cleanliness Policy**
    According to the strict Health and Safety guidelines governed by the City of Vincent and
    upheld by Perth Kitchen Hire, the Hire Kitchens must be left free of food remnants,
    contaminants and any signs of use after each hire session. Our commercial Kitchens Hire
    facilities is available to other parties to hire and therefore cleanliness is vital for
    uninterrupted use of Perth Kitchen Hire. During its operation Perth Kitchen Hire insists
    that the kitchen is to be left according to the standards set out in the Cleanliness
    Standard Checklist, which is provided prior to your first hire session.
    Thorough cleaning of the Kitchen and its equipment is required as part of your Lease
    Agreement. Should the kitchen be left in an unsatisfactory manner at the conclusion of a
    hire session an approved cleaner will be appointed by Perth Kitchen Hire at the Lessees
    expense. A cleaning fee of $60 will be deducted from your Security Bond, with no further
    notice. This is to ensure the Lessee is Handing over the Kitchen to the next customer in
    the highest standard of cleanliness, as specified in the Perth Kitchen Hire Cleanliness
    Standard Checklist document, you signed and agreed upon.
    Failure to comply with Perth Kitchen Hire’s cleanliness standards may result in the
    refusal to hire out kitchens in the future as this can cause a negative flow on effect to
    subsequent hirer’s experience with Perth Kitchen Hire.
    **Opening and Closing Down**
    This will be arranged prior to your booking with one of our Team.
    **Set Up**
    Permission may be given by Perth Kitchen Hire for you to deliver equipment to the kitchen
    up to 24 hours prior to your rental period. This is merely a gesture of good faith to
    allow the ‘Lessee’ sufficient time to set up. Please note that this request may be
    refused in instances where the kitchen is already hired to another party, or the facility
    is at full capacity.
    **Equipment Usage**
    A list of equipment included in the Kitchen for hire includes and is limited to:
    · All main equipment within kitchen i.e. ovens, oven trays, cooktops, benches and sinks.
    This does not include items stored on shelves that are rented by other hire clients.
    · Use of fridge shelving allocated for food preps, only during hire period, unless hired
    and paid for the purposes of storage.
    · All kitchen utensils and equipment such as pots, pans, utensils and electrical goods
    are to be supplied by you the client. No equipment is to be left at the kitchens unless
    storage arrangements have been made.
    · Should damage occur that renders any item unusable it is expected that it will be
    replaced as new by the Lessee.
    **Foodstuffs**
    It is expected that hirers will provide all necessary foodstuffs for their requirements.
    Perth Kitchen Hire will not provide any foodstuffs. Any foodstuffs left by the Lessee in
    the Kitchen after the hire period (refrigerated or not) will become the property of Perth
    Kitchen Hire and will in all likeliness be disposed of, unless storage arrangements have
    been made.
    **Deliveries**
    Perth Kitchen Hire is not responsible for receiving or checking deliveries and will not
    take any responsibility for incorrect deliveries. Please ensure that you have a
    representative on hand to receive or return any goods.
    **Parking**
    Perth Kitchen Hire is situated in a business strata title and parking is restricted to a
    few designated bays only. Parking bay usage differs during business and non-business
    hours. Access to the building is via the large sliding door and you can park temporarily
    outside this door to load and unload your vehicle. The carpark at the rear of the strata
    must be used during your hire session.
    **Utilities**
    Perth Kitchen Hire provides usage of utilities – water, power, gas and toilets as part of
    this rental agreement. Should it be deemed that unnecessary or excessive usage of these
    utilities occurs, then Perth Kitchen Hire reserves the right to oncharge these costs to
    the Lessee.
    **Safety**
    Should possibly dangerous situations or behaviour by the Lessee occur during their hire
    session, Perth Kitchen Hire reserves the right to shut the kitchen and any operations
    down. Should this be, directly through the actions of the renter, then all monies are
    non-refundable.
    **Food Safety**
    It is the responsibility of the Lessee to ensure you are operating within the
    requirements of the relevant Food Legislation for both the structure and Food Safety
    practices. Monitoring Food Safety requirements are undertaken by the Department of Health
    WA in conjunction with Local Governments and will not form part of the Perth Kitchen Hire
    responsibilities. All Local Government Registrations/Notifications, regarding your Food
    Business, is the responsibility of the Lessee.
    **Availability**
    Please note that all bookings are subject to availability and Perth Kitchen Hire reserves
    the right to cancel a booking should the kitchen be unusable for any OHS reason.
    **Probation Period**
    All bookings over a month will be subject to a 1-month probation period, during which
    time either party can cancel the Rental Agreement with no penalty.
    **Public Liability & Workers Compensation**
    The Lessee is required to confirm the attained Certificate of Currency for Public
    Liability & Workers Compensation and provide a copy along with the completed Rental
    Agreement.
    **Tax Invoice**
    Perth Kitchen Hire
    ABN: 28 185 842 792
    267 Scarborough Beach Road
    Mt Hawthorn, WA 6016

    **ITINERARY**
    **09.30am – Depart Riverside Adventures Base, 362 Horahora Rd, Piarere, for Jones
    Landing**
    Hired RAW bikes will be pre-loaded onto the shuttle.
    **10:15am – Arrive at Jones Landing and begin your walk to Arapuni** (Approx 40 - 60mins)
    **11.15am - Arrive in Arapuni.** Bike induction for RAW mountain bike or e-bike hires and
    option to visit Rhubarb Café.
    Self-guided ride from Arapuni back to Riverside Adventures base (approx. 14km; guideline
    about 1 hour per 10km). The Karapiro section of the Waikato River Trails is rated
    intermediate, featuring a mix of boardwalk, loose gravel surfaces, and some moderate
    inclines. Riders should have a reasonable level of fitness and confidence on uneven
    terrain.
    Check out the official Waikato River Trail website: [View
    karapiro](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/0c7c6YLXS2lRwIuS8Oiz)
    **From 12:30pm – Arrive back at Riverside Adventure Base** We recommend grabbing a bite
    to eat prior to your Twilight Kayak tour.
    **TWILIGHT KAYAK GLOW WORM TOUR**
    Start times vary throughout the year due to sunset. You will be given a separate time
    that this portion of your Triventure starts
    ##Things to Know
    - Minimum age is 10 years
    - All children under 15 to be accompanied by a capable adult
    **NOTE: Riverside Adventures has a zero alcohol & smoking policy on Glow Worm tours.**
    Evening temperatures drop as we drift back downstream... so please remember:
    - Bring warm layers of clothing preferably not cotton
    - NO JEANS as they get very cold when wet
    - We provide overpants, splash jackets & wetshoes
    - We have a changing area & secure storage
    - Cameras are okay for going upstream while it's still light - they are no good after
    dark as the flash will spoil the viewing of the Glow Worms for yourself and others on the
    tour.
    **HIGHLIGHTS**
    * Three adventures in one: walk, cycle, and Twilight Kayak Glow worm tour in a single
    day.
    * Shuttle-assisted start for an easy, stress-free day.
    * Picturesque walk to Arapuni Dam featuring striking pink ignimbrite bluffs,
    * Scenic ride along the Waikato River Trails with suspension bridges and native bush.
    * Option to stop at Rhubarb Café in Arapuni - We recommend checking hours of operation
    prior to your tour directly with the Cafe.
    * Guided Twilight Kayak glow worm tour (this runs for 4 hours).
    * Lake Karapiro views and peaceful kayaking on the river.
    **CHECK-IN DETAILS**
    Meet at Riverside Adventures Waikato Base, 362 Horahora Rd, Piarere.
    [View RAW Parking & Check in directions
    (3).pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/dWVH0MKrSwGrcH3D8vZL)
    Allow plenty of time and check Google Maps for travel;
    * 20 minutes south of Cambridge
    * 1 hour from Tauranga,
    * 1 hour from Rotorua
    * 1 hour 15 minutes from Waitomo Caves.
    **WHAT TO BRING**
    * Comfortable walking shoes or sneakers
    * Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended)
    * Water bottle
    * Sunscreen, hat, and sunglasses
    * Packed lunch or snacks
    * Small day bag/backpack
    * Towel and change of clothes (for kayaking)
    * Camera or phone for photos
    **WE PROVIDE**
    * Life jacket, splash pants & jacket, wet shoes, single/double kayak
    * Dry bag to store items you wish to take with you on the kayak
    **SPECIAL REQUIRMENTS**
    Participants must be confident riding a bike and kayaking independently. All participants
    must follow safety instructions and wear provided safety equipment where required.
    All safety briefings and instructions provided by Riverside Adventures staff must be
    followed at all times.
    If wanting to upgrade from Standard Mountain bike to eBike, do get in touch.
    **DISCLAIMERS**
    This is a self-guided experience and operates in all weather conditions; Riverside
    Adventures is not responsible for weather on the day. Ride times are estimates and may
    vary depending on fitness levels and time spent at stops. Minimum numbers may apply for
    shuttle departures. It is the customer’s responsibility to check Rhubarb Café opening
    hours if planning to visit.
    Children must be a minimum of 10yrs old and must be supervised by an adult at all times.
    Participants are responsible for their own safety and should carry water,
    weather-appropriate clothing, and any personal items required for the duration of the
    activity.
    **TWILIGHT KAYAK TOUR PORTION OF YOUR TRIVENTURE**
    **What's included**
    * Safety Briefing and paddling instruction.
    * Guide.
    * Splash pants and jackets.
    * PFD (personal Flotation Device).
    * Wetshoes provided.
    * Changing area and secure storage available.
    * Dry bag to store personal items in while kayaking.
    * Warm woollen socks (during Winter)
    * Plenty of parking onsite.
    **Itinerary**
    **Arrive & check-in**– Arrive at our base and check in and get fitted with your gear. You
    will be sent a text message the day of your tour confirming the exact time of check in.
    **Safety briefing & setup** – Meet your guides for a safety briefing and basic paddling
    instruction before heading out.
    **Paddle across Lake Karapiro** – Begin with a gentle paddle along the lake edge, passing
    the submerged Horahora Dam while your guide shares local history.
    **Enter the Pokaiwhenua Stream** – As the light fades, paddle into the sheltered canyon
    surrounded by native bush and birdlife. Continue upstream (approx. 1–1.15 hours / 1.5km)
    **Stretch & explore** – There’s an opportunity to step out of your kayak, stretch your
    legs, and hear more about the history of the area before continuing. Stop for a 30-minute
    break.
    **Glow worm experience** –Once darkness falls, retrace your path as you drift quietly
    back down the stream beneath a stunning display of glow worms lighting up the canyon
    walls.
    **Return to base** – Continue your relaxed paddle back to base, taking in the peaceful
    night-time atmosphere.(approx. 45 minutes). covering around 3km in total.
    **What to bring**
    * Weather-appropriate clothing (layers recommended).
    * Camera for photos while upstream in daylight.
    **Special requirements**
    * Minimum age is 10 years; all children under 15 must be accompanied by a capable adult
    or guardian; ratio of 1 adult per child.
    * Please advise us in advance of any medical conditions, injuries, or mobility concerns.
    * A reasonable level of fitness is required.
    * All participants must follow safety instructions and wear provided safety equipment
    where required.
    * Evening temperatures drop during the return downstream.
    **Restrictions**
    * No jeans (they get very cold when wet)
    * Flash photography after dark is not allowed as it spoils viewing of glow worms for
    yourself and others. You can use cameras going upstream while its still light.
    * Minimum age is 10 years. All children must be accompanied by an adult or guardian, with
    a ratio of 1 adult per child.
    If you do not meet this ratio (e.g. 1 adult with 2 children), please get in touch—an
    additional guide can be arranged to accompany a child at an extra cost.
    * Advertised weight limit for kayaking is 120kg.
    **NOTE: Riverside Adventures has zero alcohol & smoking policy on Glow Worm Tours.**
    **Disclaimers**
    * Bookings are essential and minimum participant numbers apply.
    * This is a guided outdoor activity and operates in most weather conditions.
    * All participants must be able to understand and follow safety instructions delivered in
    English.
    * If participants are unable to understand English, they must arrange their own
    translator to accompany them.
    * Riverside Adventures Waikato reserves the right to refuse participation if safety
    instructions cannot be clearly understood.
    * Participants must be physically able to paddle.
    * If, after the initial paddle on Lake Karapiro, a participant is deemed unable to safely
    kayak, they will be guided back to base and no refund will be given.
    * Late arrivals may miss the safety briefing and may not be able to join the tour.
    * No refunds will be given for no-shows or late arrivals.
    Here is our link to FAQS :
    [View faqs](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/HP62aRBR7iFlfBKtVY9Z)

    Thank you for enrolling to Try Scuba Diving – we’re thrilled to have you join us.
    Scuba diving lets you step into an entirely different environment, full of colour, calm,
    and adventure. It can open the door to exploring shipwrecks, reefs, and underwater
    landscapes that feel almost otherworldly. Whatever draws you to the ocean, we’re excited
    to help you on your journey.
    Below is some important information to help you prepare for your dive. If anything is
    unclear, please feel free to ask any questions.
    **Equipment**
    All equipment is included for use while you Try Scuba Diving. If you already own personal
    items such as a mask or snorkel, you’re welcome to bring them. We also have equipment
    available for purchase if you’d like to start building your own dive kit.
    **Register and complete your short course materials**
    To begin your training, you’ll need to create an **SSI account** (at
    [https://my.divessi.com](https://my.divessi.com)) and affiliate with **Dive Eden**. This
    will give you access to your online learning materials and the required forms. Please
    complete the short course materials and documents before your first training day.
    **To set up your SSI account:**
    Create your profile at [https://my.divessi.com](https://my.divessi.com) and affiliate
    with **Dive Eden**. Please reach out once you've created your MySSI profile and your
    course materials will be allocated within 48 hours.
    **Before your course commences, within MySSI, please ensure you have:**
    - Created an account and affiliated with Dive Eden
    - Completed all online course materials and the final exam. You can access your materials
    under **“Courses”** in the MySSI App or under **“Training”** on the website.
    - Completed the Fit to Dive Screening†, Responsible Diver Code, and Assumption of Risk &
    - Liability Waiver (found in the “Documents” section and also attached here - [View Try
    Scuba SSI Forms.pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/uSKCnwQbQI2qFw24rd9Q))
    - Added your home address to your profile
    - Uploaded a profile photo (no sunglasses, hats, or masks — but smiling is encouraged)
    **†Important health note:**
    Recreational scuba diving and freediving require good physical and mental health. Some
    medical conditions can increase the risks associated with diving. The **Fit to Dive
    Screening** questions help determine whether you need to complete an additional **Diver
    Medical Participant Questionnaire** (attached here - [View Diver Medical Participant
    Questionnaire.pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/kRibxVjPQhOrQYrpSsVO)) or should be
    assessed by a physician before participating. For your safety — and the safety of those
    diving with you — please answer all questions honestly and well in advance of the course
    to allow time for any questions. If you are feeling unwell at any time, it’s important to
    avoid diving.
    **Approximate schedule**
    - 9:00am – Meet at Strickland Lane, Eden, for paperwork and equipment collection
    - 9:30am – Self-drive to the dive site, or arrange a seat in our vehicle (2-3 seats
    available. Site between 5-25 mins drive TBC), set up equipment and dive briefing
    - 10:15am - Start of dive, approximately 30-60mins
    - Debriefing and equipment care
    - 12pm - Approximate finish time
    **What to bring**
    - Post dive snacks, and water
    - Sunscreen and any personal snorkelling or diving gear you already own
    - Swimwear
    - Towel and warm clothes for after the dive
    - Completed forms attached (if not completed online in MySSI)
    - Enthusiasm and a sense of adventure
    **How to find us**
    We’ll meet at the Dive Eden shed to collect equipment. You’ll find us on **Strickland
    Lane, Eden**, underneath **Brent Dunne Design**.
    Alternatively, you can park on the main street and walk through the arcade between Mark
    Anthony’s and Anna Warren’s Gallery, then head down the staircase at the back.
    (Please note: Google Maps may direct you incorrectly. Look for BD Design, an open shed,
    and our green *Dive Eden* Landcruiser.)
